recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If Patient Care wants the recordedDate comment itself to restate the recorder contrast again, handle that as a new paired Condition and AllergyIntolerance decision because the sentence was deliberately removed by FHIR-34395 and the current recorder comments already express the distinction.
issue_request: FHIR-34396 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked to align AllergyIntolerance.recordedDate and AllergyIntolerance.recorder with Condition recordedDate/recorder definition, comments, and mappings. The approved resolution updated AllergyIntolerance.recordedDate short/comment text and added a recorder comment clarifying the most-recent-author versus first-recorded distinction.
initial_application: The source history shows e729df8464552643d743d1fab578d39af592854a (J#34396 AllergyIntolerance recorder and recordedDate clarifications) applying the requested AllergyIntolerance.recordedDate short/comment and recorder comment. The Jira comments cite the associated GitHub PR/merge path, including 83f965b.
additional_context: FHIR-34395 was applied shortly afterward to both Condition and AllergyIntolerance, replacing recorder/asserter with participant and explicitly removing the final recordedDate sentence that contrasted recorder as the most recent author. Later R6 decisions FHIR-39513, FHIR-44517, and FHIR-39602 reverted the participant model back to recorder/asserter, and FHIR-48804 clarified the recorder definition in both resources to say the recorder takes responsibility for accurately recording the content. Current Condition and AllergyIntolerance remain aligned: recordedDate retains onset/preservation guidance without the struck contrast sentence, while recorder carries the most-recent-author/first-recorded comment.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Re-adding the recordedDate contrast sentence only to AllergyIntolerance would break alignment with Condition, and re-adding it to both resources would reverse the later FHIR-34395 decision without a new work-group decision. The current AllergyIntolerance source is in build scope and already preserves the meaningful FHIR-34396 clarification through the recordedDate short/comment and recorder definition/comment/mappings.
